div.head: Hn 48.10
div.ab: Et de cremento feudi debet haberi testis eiusdem dominii, uel ex sua uel ex parte domini etiam inuocatus.
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 571 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)

note.seg: das Wort steht Domesday I 64b 1. Hier etwa Zuwachs im Gegensatz zu primo feodo (Hauptgut) 48, 11? oder ist tenemento zu emendiren; vgl. ses pers de la tenure meimes apelerad a testimonie (Leis Wl 23)

the word occurs in Domesday I 64b 1. Here perhaps increment, in contrast to primo feodo (principal holding) 48, 11? Or should tenemento be read by emendation? cf. ses pers de la tenure meimes apelerad a testimonie (Leis Wl 23)
Der Ggs. ist, dass hier nur Vassallen desselben Lehns, in 48, 11 auch andere Freie zeugen dürfen—aduocatus{48}—48, 11 feodo h. quinque l. si n. possunt Rs
The contrast is that here only vassals of the same fief may act as witnesses, but in 48, 11 other free men too—aduocatus{48}—48, 11 feodo h. quinque l. si n. possunt Rs

div.ab: And concerning an increase of a fee a witness of the same lordship ought to be had, even if called on either from his own side or from the lord's.
